guard: one-shot channel history stays inside the authenticated single-filter lifecycle grant and never takes over or deletes another process reader
why: The public production page API reads a real JWT-auth broker without any provisioned ACL mirror. Named cells exercise real create-only occupancy, same- and different-channel contention, cancellation, delayed old-owner completion, a native iterator stop and malformed stored rows. A mutation must fail its named cell, not an earlier broker error or timeout.
